verdict.rationale: Apple provides mature first-party toolchains (Xcode, Metal, Metal debugger, Core ML, PyTorch Metal backend, MLX) all targeting Apple Silicon, indicating tier-one OS/tooling support and optimization guidance (docs-1,6,7,8,9,10,11). However, there's no independent evidence of compiler maturity (e.g., LLVM/GCC optimization benchmarks) or third-party developer corroboration beyond Apple's own claims, and community discussion is skeptical/comparative rather than confirming dev-tooling maturity. Missing for 10: independent compiler/optimization benchmarks, third-party developer testimony on toolchain maturity, non-Apple corroboration of 'tier one' treatment.
